explanation: This unit is only active at D1. There it reads about 4-7 when the previous trial was rewarded and about 1-3 when it was not, it climbs with time in the episode (a rewarded D1 is about 4 before trial 20 and 8-10 after trial 85; an unrewarded D1 late in the episode is still 5-8), and GO and D2 are almost always 0-1, rising to 2-4 only in the last ~10 trials.
